title: Work order
description: One unit of work: making one medium of one Moment. The document is a record; every state change produces a new copy with a higher seq. Times are integer epoch seconds supplied by the caller.

version.description: Ledger record version; 2 today. Any integer from 1 parses, so older stored records stay readable.

seq.description: Bumped by every state change. The storage layer compares and swaps on it.

order_id.description: Also the idempotency key: registering the same result twice yields one take.

scope_id.description: The scene the Moment belongs to. A take awaiting a person holds later orders of the same scope only.

sequence.description: The Moment's place in production order. Reissues keep it.

canon_revision.description: The approved Canon revision the order is pinned to.

depends_on.description: story-core node keys (story_revision_domains, bare kind/id, e.g. character/rhea) this Moment's work leans on, the union over the narrative and production domains. Opaque to the ledger: compared as strings with changed_domains. No entry repeats.

lease_seconds.description: Length of the lease in seconds.

assignee.description: The member the order is bound to; null while unclaimed.

lease_expires_at.description: Epoch seconds the lease ends; null while unclaimed or once the work is done.

anchor.description: A cut later cuts lean on (first appearance, new costume, new location).

policy.description: Per-Moment override of the project's review policy; null means follow the project.

contention_group.description: Orders in one group are deliberate overlaps on the same Moment and medium.

participant.description: In a contention group: the one member this order is for.

profile_id.description: In a contention group: the model profile this order is for, when fixed. On a winner's remake: the profile that won, as a hint.

after_order_ids.description: Anchor orders this one waits on until a person approves their take. Followed through reissues by successor_id.

successor_id.description: The order that replaced this one.

revision_notes.description: The reviewer's notes a remake must address.

direction_revisions.description: Canon revisions the current direction and receipt are valid for. A Canon change that misses depends_on extends this instead of voiding the work.

closed_by.description: The person who approved, rejected, withdrew or superseded. A policy confirmation leaves it null and sets confirmed_by_policy.

$comment: Not expressible: which fields must be set in which state (assignee and lease_expires_at while working, take_id once recorded, close_reason once closed) is enforced by the transition functions, not by parsing. For every nullable field an absent key and a null mean the same; writers should still emit every field.
